entries.match: The best time to plant a tree
entries.editorial_status: KEEP THE THOUGHT - DROP THE CULTURAL ATTRIBUTION - ILLUMINATION. 'A familiar saying' rather than 'a proverb', because even proverb-status has a relatively modern transmission history here. This preserves what actually earns the interruption - the image of planting now - without manufacturing Chinese ancestry or ancient provenance.
entries.attributed_as_note: cultural attribution removed; carried as a familiar saying with no claimed origin
entries.evidence_location: QUOTATION_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md (earliest strong match: Cleveland councilman George W. White, Cleveland Plain Dealer 1967, who disclaimed credit; the 'Chinese proverb' label first appears in a Nebraska newspaper in 1985); 4C Chapter 7 ruling
entries.notes: FORM CHANGE: was a block epigraph, now runs as prose. Wording also modernised from '20 years ago' to 'twenty years ago'.

entries.match: He who has a 'why' to live

Apparatus note to Stage 7.
